seo.title: About CompassAI — CourseCadence
seo.description: Learn about CompassAI, the team behind CourseCadence, and our mission to help students manage college life.

hero.headline: We're building the college companion we wish we'd had
hero.lead: CompassAI creates tools that help students handle the jump to college. CourseCadence, our first product, turns a stack of syllabi into one personalized plan so students can focus on learning instead of logistics.

mission.heading: Our mission
mission.body:
College asks students to manage more at once than ever before: several courses, each with its own syllabus, deadlines and expectations, along with jobs, sports, family and a social life.

We believe no student should have to work all of that out alone. Our mission is to give every student a calm, clear view of what's next and a plan that adapts when life happens.

We design with students, not just for them. Every feature starts from real conversations about what makes college hard.
mission.imageAlt: Students working in a college classroom

values.heading: What we believe
values.intro: The principles behind every decision we make about CourseCadence.

cards.title: Students first
cards.body: We build for the student's long-term success, not for screen time. A good day in CourseCadence is one where you open it, know what to do and get back to your life.

cards.title: Flexible, not rigid
cards.body: Plans should bend when life happens. Missed a session? CourseCadence reworks the rest of your week instead of making you feel behind.

cards.title: Privacy by default
cards.body: Your schedule and coursework belong to you. We collect only what we need to build your plan and never sell student data.

stories.heading: What students are saying
stories.intro: Early feedback from students using CourseCadence.

quotes.quote: As a first-year, I had no idea how much time each class really needed. CourseCadence took the guesswork out of it, and my grades showed it.
The best part is that it adjusts when life happens. I missed two sessions during midterms, and instead of making me feel behind, it just reworked the rest of my week.

team.heading: Meet the team
team.intro: Educators, engineers and recent grads who remember how hard the transition can be.

cta.heading: Ready to take the chaos out of college?
cta.text: Try CourseCadence free for 30 days. No credit card required.
